title: Rivulet Signature Peridot Ring
description: A fluid sculptural form inspired by natural meandering watercourses, hand-carved in micro-crystalline wax and cast in 24k gold-plated brass crowned with an untreated vivid green Zambian peridot gemstone.

accordions.craftsmanship: Individually hand-forged by generational master metalsmiths utilizing lost-wax casting and hand-burnished high polish finish.
accordions.care: Shield from perfume, chlorine, and abrasive chemicals. Store individually in the provided velvet atelier pouch.
accordions.delivery: Complimentary worldwide insured express courier. Ships in luxury presentation gift box with physical Certificate of Authenticity.

title: Tarakasi Filigree Bloom Earrings
description: Delicate gossamer wire drawing hand-twisted into ethereal botanical silhouettes by master Tarakasi artisans. Each wire is thinner than a strand of silk.

accordions.craftsmanship: Hand-drawn fine metallic wire bent with precision tweezers and welded without solder stains by 4th-generation filigree masters.
accordions.care: Store flat in padded velvet case. Clean only with a dry microfiber cloth; never immerse in ultrasonic cleaners.
accordions.delivery: Dispatched within 48 hours in signature gold-foiled rigid packaging accompanied by craft provenance documentation.

title: Royal Polki & Pearl Choker
material: Uncut Polki Stones, Basra Pearls & 22k Gold Foil

specs.dimensions: 340mm choker arc with adjustable silk tie

accordions.craftsmanship: Centuries-old Jadau technique combining lac-core filling, pure gold foil burnishing, and reverse-side floral Meenakari detailing.
accordions.care: Store wrapped in muslin cloth inside airtight presentation box. Keep dry and avoid direct contact with cosmetic sprays.
accordions.delivery: Hand-packaged in silk-lined jewelry chest with numbered certification card.

title: Mayur Heritage Kundan Pendant
description: A regal peacock silhouette celebrating majesty and grace, sculpted in 24k gold foil setting with a pigeon-blood ruby cabochon heart and vivid mineral enamel plumage on the reverse.

accordions.craftsmanship: Traditional Kundan setting utilizing ultra-refined 99.9% pure gold foils pressed cold around each gemstone contour.
accordions.care: Polish with soft flannel cloth. Avoid exposure to water, extreme humidity, or alcohol-based fragrances.
accordions.delivery: Insured courier delivery within 3-4 business days in plush velvet jewelry cassette.

title: Chandrakala Hand-Engraved Kadas
description: Twin masterwork kadas sculpted with raised botanical repoussé and chasing. A hidden threaded screw clasp ensures flawless wrist contouring and weight balance.

accordions.craftsmanship: Formed from solid brass core layered with heavy 5-micron 22k gold vermeil and engraved entirely by hand with hardened steel chisels.
accordions.care: Store wrapped in protective velvet sleeves. Wipe with dry flannel after each wear to preserve the satin-sheen luster.
accordions.delivery: Presented in handcrafted wooden keepsake box with velvet interior.

title: Padma Lotus Statement Cocktail Ring
material: Rose Quartz, Pavé Emeralds & 22k Gold Vermeil
description: Multi-tiered lotus blossom ring with hand-carved natural rose quartz petals opening towards a pavé-set Colombian emerald pistil. The ring band features ergonomic comfort-fit contouring.

accordions.craftsmanship: Lapidary petal carving paired with microscope-assisted micro-pavé gemstone setting in 22k gold over sterling silver.
accordions.care: Gently cleanse with mild soapy water and a soft-bristle brush if needed. Dry immediately with lint-free cloth.
accordions.delivery: Dispatched in custom embossed ring box with international warranty documentation.

title: Jaipur Meenakari Regal Hasli Choker
description: Solid contoured torque collar necklace adorned with intricate five-color vitreous enamel depicting courtly floral vines, fired five distinct times in high-temperature muffle kilns.

accordions.care: Enamel is vitreous glass; protect from sharp impact and sudden temperature shocks. Store laid flat in velvet drawer.
accordions.delivery: Packaged in custom embroidered velvet case accompanied by a numbered certificate of craftsmanship.

title: Bengal Heritage Temple Jhumkas
description: Cascading bell-shaped jhumkas celebrating timeless temple architecture, featuring pierced dome work with dancing freshwater seed pearl fringes that resonate with gentle movement.

accordions.craftsmanship: Individually pierced filigree dome with micro-soldered jump rings and hand-knotted natural pearls.
accordions.care: Keep protected from hairspray and moisture. Always store flat in anti-tarnish jewelry pouches.
accordions.delivery: Ships worldwide via insured courier in commemorative SSRINI gift presentation packaging.

title: Imperial Navratna Cuff Bracelet

accordions.craftsmanship: Individually calibrated gemstone settings positioned strictly according to traditional Vedic astronomical orientations.
